serving_geometry_basis: Raw-audio official-protocol cell on build 04ccc72a with the bf16 mmproj loaded, derived from the MEASURED prompt fit of 2026-09-04 (docs/checks/speech-aware-evidence-acquisition/2026-09-04-a2t-official-protocol-replication-400-v1/prompt-fit/prompt-fit.json, sha256 3aa8a34d5816...). The published protocol's compact registry renders to 3,581 text tokens through the pinned template -- 9,655 fewer than the legacy registry text's 13,236 and 10,333 fewer than the native tools envelope's 13,914 -- so the worst request needs 3,581 + 468 measured speech tokens + 256 completion ceiling + 2 special = 4,307 tokens, against a calibration worst of 14,730/15,408. Geometry rule (preregistration section 6 item 3): take the largest slot count whose per-slot window still clears worst-required + the 8,192-token reserve, holding total context at the 49,152 the calibration's raw-audio server is already proven to serve on this GPU. 49,152/3 = 16,384 per slot leaves a margin of 12,077 (>= 8,192); 49,152/4 = 12,288 leaves 7,981, which is 211 tokens SHORT of the reserve, so -np 4 is refused. 16,384 is a multiple of 512, so llama-server's own rounding cannot make the live slot disagree with the declared one -- GET /props reported exactly 16,384. core.flight.FlightRuntime.serve derives -np/-c from the adapter's serving_geometry(), so slots x slot_tokens must equal the -c above exactly. This is one MORE slot than the calibration's raw cells could serve (they were forced to -np 2 by a ~15k-token envelope), which is a direct consequence of the published prompt being 3.7x shorter than the reconstruction.
decoding_basis: max_tokens 256 is the published protocol's own max_new_tokens (audio_benchmark/models/qwen3_omni.py generate() default and configs/example_config.yaml, commit b9d5383c), not this repository's 1024. temperature 0 is the greedy equivalent of the release's do_sample=false (its temperature 1.0 is inert under greedy decoding, and its own vLLM adapter is the sampling variant this cell does not fly). The seed stays this study's 20260803 rather than the release's 42; under greedy decoding a seed selects nothing, so the difference is recorded and inert.
